description: Erection of a first floor extension to form an additional storey to the existing bungalow
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement & Fire Safety Statement. Received on 18/07/2022; PL1/SM/0108 - 00 Rev B, PL1/SM/0108 - 02 Rev B, PL1/SM/0108 - 03 Rev B, PL1/SM/0108 - 04 Rev B & PL1/SM/0108 - 05 Rev B. Received on 26/08/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the additional floor hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Fridays and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the rear elevation at first floor level of the development hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the property (1 Dorchester Drive) or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of its site shall be carried out.
